description: Turns a Perigee link or embed URL (from perigee_view or a shared link) into words: a one-sentence alternative text for the image or iframe, and a description for lesson notes (which view, the selected object, where it is and how reliable its position is, the date and speed of time, the frame, the filters and what is hidden). The camera framing is not in the link.

lang.description: Language of names and texts (default en).

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for local times, e.g. "Europe/Paris".

name: perigee_describe_view
title: Describe a view
